phases.final:
Implemented the lifecycle repair in `src/index.ts`.

- Synchronous fetch results now settle correctly.
- Internal fetch Promise placeholders no longer reach `onInsert`.
- Fetch completion is distinguished from replacement, avoiding self-abort.
- Insert/update/replace status and callbacks use the actual stale value; unchanged values are not disposed.
- Eviction aborts in-flight fetches and disposes their stale values through both disposal callbacks.
- Late results cannot resurrect evicted entries or overwrite replacement entries.
